text:
Before the meal, the tray held:
- 3 sushi roll pieces, about 25 g each (75 g total), at roughly 1.5 kcal/g, giving about 110 kcal.
- 2 spring rolls, about 100 g each (200 g total). These look fried or tofu-wrapped, so I used roughly 1.6 kcal/g, giving about 320 kcal.
- A glass of juice, about 250 g at roughly 0.45 kcal/g, giving about 112 kcal.
- Soy sauce, about 30 g, of which some was eaten.
- Pickled ginger, about 20 g.

After the meal:
- All the food and the juice are gone.
- The ginger appears mostly eaten, so I counted about 15 g, giving about 10 kcal.
- The soy sauce cup still holds some sauce, and spilled sauce is on the plate. I counted about 10 g eaten, giving about 5 kcal.

Totals:
- Mass: 75 + 200 + 250 + 15 + 10 = 550 g.
- Energy: 110 + 320 + 112 + 10 + 5 = 557 kcal.
